conventions: Write TSDoc in /** ... */ blocks starting with a one-sentence summary, followed by an optional @remarks section separated by a blank comment line.
Format parameter tags as '@param <name> - <description>' with the hyphen required by TSDoc and no trailing period on single-sentence descriptions.
Place @returns and @throws after @param tags, and place release tags (@public) last when applicable.
Do not add @public or @alpha tags to interface properties or class methods because they inherit the release tag of their enclosing interface or class.
Preserve the existing @public tag as the last tag on each top-level exported function in packages/catalog-model/src/entity/conditions.ts.
Use {@link Symbol} or {@link https://...} for cross-references and wrap TSDoc lines at approximately 80 columns to match Prettier.
Modify only /** ... */ TSDoc comments in the 15 TypeScript source files; never alter types, signatures, exports, release tags, copyright headers, or runtime code.

decisions.topic: Kind interface member TSDoc scope and kind field wording
decisions.choice: Document only the 3 top-level members (apiVersion, kind, spec) on each of the 8 V1alpha1 kind interfaces without adding comments to nested spec properties, and state the literal kind value expected by the type and its schema validator without saying it is 'always' that value since is<Kind>Entity compares entity.kind.toUpperCase().
rejected: Adding TSDoc comments to nested properties inside spec
Stating that kind is always the exact-case literal string
decisions.reason: Only the 3 top-level members are reported as undocumented by API Extractor, and Gate 1 explicitly decided against 'always' because the type guard narrows case-insensitively.

decisions.topic: Release tags on documented members, methods, and functions
decisions.choice: Omit @public on interface properties and class methods while keeping @public as the final tag on the 8 top-level functions in conditions.ts.
rejected: Adding @public to interface properties and class methods
decisions.reason: Interface members and class methods inherit their parent's release tag in API Extractor, matching Entity.ts and CommonValidatorFunctions.ts.

decisions.choice: Leave packages/catalog-model/report.api.md and packages/catalog-model/report-alpha.api.md out of typed units so yarn build:api-reports regenerates them.
rejected: Hand-editing report.api.md and report-alpha.api.md as spec units
decisions.reason: API reports are generated build outputs verified and updated by yarn build:api-reports.

rules: 1. Document each of isApiEntity, isComponentEntity, isDomainEntity, isGroupEntity, isLocationEntity, isResourceEntity, isSystemEntity, and isUserEntity as a TypeScript type guard narrowing Entity to the corresponding {@link <Kind>Entity} type.

3. Include '@param entity - The entity to check' (or equivalent hyphenated @param tag), '@returns', and preserve '@public' as the final tag on every function without changing any function signature or body.

units.behaviour: Add TSDoc comments to the 8 static validator methods on KubernetesValidatorFunctions.
rules: 1. Document isValidApiVersion: checks that value is a valid apiVersion string on the form <suffix> or <prefix>/<suffix> (via CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidPrefixAndOrSuffix with '/'), where optional <prefix> is a valid RFC 1123 DNS subdomain (CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain: 1-253 chars of dot-separated DNS labels, each 1-63 lowercase ASCII alphanumeric chars [a-z0-9] starting and ending with [a-z0-9] and allowing internal hyphens '-') and <suffix> is 1-63 ASCII alphanumeric chars ([a-z0-9A-Z]+, rejecting hyphens, underscores, and dots).

2. Document isValidKind: checks that value is a valid kind string of 1-63 characters starting with an ASCII letter ([a-zA-Z]) followed by zero or more ASCII alphanumeric characters ([a-z0-9A-Z]*), rejecting leading digits, hyphens, punctuation, empty strings, strings over 63 chars, and non-strings.

3. Document isValidObjectName: checks that value is a valid object name string of 1-63 characters starting and ending with an ASCII alphanumeric character ([A-Za-z0-9]) with only ASCII alphanumeric characters, hyphens ('-'), underscores ('_'), and dots ('.') in between (/^([A-Za-z0-9][-A-Za-z0-9_.]*)?[A-Za-z0-9]$/), accepting uppercase letters and consecutive internal separators.

4. Document isValidNamespace: checks that value is a valid namespace string by delegating to {@link CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsLabel} (RFC 1123 DNS label: 1-63 lowercase ASCII alphanumeric characters [a-z0-9] and internal hyphens '-', starting and ending with [a-z0-9], rejecting uppercase letters, underscores, and dots).

5. Document isValidLabelKey: checks that value is a valid label key string on the form <name> or <prefix>/<name> (via CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidPrefixAndOrSuffix with '/'), where optional <prefix> is a valid DNS subdomain (CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain, 1-253 chars) and <name> is a valid object name (KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidObjectName, 1-63 chars).

6. Document isValidLabelValue: checks that value is a valid label value string, accepting either an empty string ('') or a valid object name (KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidObjectName, 1-63 chars).

7. Document isValidAnnotationKey: checks that value is a valid annotation key string on the form <name> or <prefix>/<name> (via CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidPrefixAndOrSuffix with '/'), where optional <prefix> is a valid DNS subdomain (CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain, 1-253 chars) and <name> is a valid object name (KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidObjectName, 1-63 chars), using the same rule as isValidLabelKey.

8. Document isValidAnnotationValue: checks that value is a valid annotation value, accepting any string (typeof value === 'string') including an empty string '' with no length or character restrictions.
9. Include '@param value - The value to check' on each method and do not add @public tags to the static methods.

units.behaviour: Add a TSDoc comment to FieldFormatEntityPolicy.enforce.
rules: 1. Document that enforce validates the format of the entity's envelope fields using the configured Validators instance (defaulting to makeValidator()): required apiVersion (isValidApiVersion), kind (isValidKind), and metadata.name (isValidEntityName); and optional metadata.namespace (isValidNamespace), metadata.labels keys and values (isValidLabelKey, isValidLabelValue), metadata.annotations keys and values (isValidAnnotationKey, isValidAnnotationValue), metadata.tags items (isValidTag), and metadata.links items (requiring url via CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidUrl, and validating optional title and icon via CommonValidatorFunctions.isNonEmptyString).
2. Note that it does not check metadata.uid, metadata.etag, metadata.title, metadata.description, metadata.links[].type, or spec.

3. Include '@param entity - The entity to validate', '@returns' (resolves with the unmodified entity if all checked fields are valid), and '@throws' (rejects with an Error if a required field is undefined or null, if a validator throws, or if any checked field fails validation), without adding @public to the method.
